task_name: DDC New Delhi events and actions digest
instruction:
Inspect up to the 12 most recent substantive top-level messages in #ddc-new-delhi and their relevant threads. Extract every explicitly mentioned event, meeting,
    announcement, deadline, location, organizer, and requested action. Produce a chronological digest and a separate list of upcoming or still-actionable items based only on dates
    and wording visible in Slack. Clearly mark missing dates or locations as not stated. Do not send, edit, delete, react to, or otherwise modify any Slack content.
